_comment: Committed format-version-2 (compact record) vectors. Generated once, deliberately, by gen_vectors_test.go -write-compact-vectors, each with a fixed DEK and a fixed salt so the ciphertext is reproducible; see docs/format.md, 'Test vectors'. TestVectors_MatchCommittedTestdata decrypts each entry's ciphertext_hex directly. It must never be replaced by re-encrypting plaintext_hex and comparing, since the whole point is to catch a silent wire-format change that a round trip cannot. If a committed ciphertext stops decrypting, that is a real failure, not a vector to refresh. Three vectors are committed because one cannot discriminate: a single-component address does not exercise the component count in the AAD, an empty value does not exercise the ciphertext body, and a value whose bytes are all printable would not catch a plaintext that was somehow text-normalised. salt_hex is recorded only so the fixture's provenance is auditable; the decoder reads the salt from the record itself, as every real reader does.
